entries.description: Reproduced: the classify-against-HomeHealthCare COM test timed out at 240s in both the batch run and a targeted retry during the prior set's re-measurement (2026-06-01); persistent and deterministic.

Per-phase timed instrumentation completed (session-1-timing-evidence.md). Reproduced the classify path in-process: Phase A schema read 6.42s (of which DAO/Access-COM augmentation 6.35s), Phase B value sampling 0.16s, overall 6.87s. The spec's prime suspect (DISTINCT-subquery cardinality) is DISPROVEN: all 93 cardinality queries total 0.06s (max 2ms); fixture is 13 tables/93 cols, largest 62 rows. Then reproduced the REAL failure: the classify CLI *process* never exits (242s WaitForExit timeout) -- it wedges in native COM un-init at managed shutdown AFTER writing correct output, with no surviving msaccess.exe (accumulated 4 live AccessHarvester.exe zombies, reaped only by WMI Win32_Process.Terminate). dotnet-stack could not attach (native wedge). Fix-direction probes: Environment.Exit does NOT help; hard TerminateProcess after flush exits cleanly in 7s with correct exit code and no zombie.

Authored root-cause-findings.md (evidence-anchored, spec premise overturned) and ai-assignment.md (routed analysis). Root cause: classify CLI process wedges in native COM un-initialization at managed shutdown after completing all work (~7s). Routed a cross-provider consensus on fix-vs-quarantine: gpt-5-4 -> Option 3 (quarantine for the bounded spike, blast-radius concern), gemini-pro -> Option 2 (hard-terminate, fixes test+consumer). Both confirmed the root cause sound. Split escalated to the human, who chose Option 2 SCOPED (flush-then-TerminateProcess on the COM command path, quarantine fallback) and folded in the E5 'Property not found' DAO HRESULT fix. Spec Session 2 + likely-root-cause-area corrected to match the evidence.
